changes.reason: Use exclusive local file creation to preserve another scaffold writer when overwrite is disabled; retain explicit direct-overwrite and error recovery semantics.

kubernetes.reason: This change protects local CLI scaffold files using the existing Node filesystem API. It does not execute in an application Host, alter deployed storage or lifecycle contracts, or introduce a Provider or deployment support claim.
constraints: Exclusive creation depends on the filesystem honoring the existing Node wx open flag; direct writes are not atomic replacement or rollback.
